subject: Post-call: private deployment token economics & license model options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orionhealth.com>, Ben Rodgers <brodgers@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: private deployment token economics & license model options

Samira / Ben — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed on so we can get you a concrete estimate for Private (VPC/on‑prem) deployment: 

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Expected steady-state ingestion: ~40M tokens/day (peak ~55M/day) across two product teams.
- Latency target: 200–300ms p95 for simple generation paths.
- Security: customer-managed keys, SOC2 evidence required.
- Preferred support: leaning toward Premium (24x7 SLA + quarterly reviews).

Immediate questions we promised to clarify (we're looking for your answers so pricing can be scoped):
1) Environment count: dev/staging/prod + DR — can you confirm how many distinct envs you want isolated? (we used 4 in the examples)
2) Enrollment/budget cadence: do you prefer an annual committed capacity contract or an initial 12-month pilot with monthly true-ups?
3) Target unit economics: you mentioned a target ~$4k / 1M tokens for gross cost (including infra & license). Is that still the target range or should we aim for a different $/1M token number?

What we'll produce next (deliverables):
- One‑page recommended commercial structure (commit vs pilot) with breakouts: dedicated GPU capacity + per‑token overage economics.
- Pricing sheet with examples for 4 vs 8 environment layouts and support-tier deltas.
- SOC2 artifacts checklist and onboarding timeline.

Attachments: redwood-onepage-priv-econ.pdf (summary), redwood-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx (worked examples) — sending now, see links below.

Next steps / ask from you: please confirm environment count and whether the $4k / 1M tokens target is your internal expectation. If you want to keep to budget range, we'll back-solve capacity + license to hit that number and flag any trade-offs.

I'll follow up with a short pricing summary and proposed calendar for a 30‑minute pricing walkthrough once you confirm.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@orionhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Rodgers <brodgers@orionhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: private deployment token economics & license model options

Thanks, Jordan — good summary. A few direct answers from our side: 

1) Environments: We'll want dev, staging, prod, and a hot standby DR environment — so 4 distinct environments. We expect prod to be ~70% of the total traffic, staging ~15%, dev ~10%, DR ~5%.
2) Contract preference: procurement prefers an annual committed model (for budget predictability) but legal wants an initial pilot clause (60–90 days) to validate perf and integration before full commit. Would you model a 6‑month ramp with an annual true‑up?
3) Unit economics: Our finance team flagged internal target of $3.5k–$4.5k / 1M tokens (total TCO target). If you can show a committed-capacity structure that lands near $4k/1M at our expected volumes, procurement will be happy to fast-track.

Other notes: please include an explicit overage rate and the cadence for usage reporting (we prefer daily + monthly summary). Also mark the support SLA tier and escalation path (we'll need a named customer success lead for the pilot).

Appreciate the attachments — we'll review and get back with any questions.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Head of AI Platforms, Orion Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@orionhealth.com>, Ben Rodgers <brodgers@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: private deployment token economics & license model options

Samira — looping in high-level commercial options and a proposed approach from our side. Jordan, feel free to forward this as the pricing note.

High-level commercial constructs we recommend to meet Orion's $/1M token target at 40M tokens/day:
- Option A — Committed capacity (recommended):
  - Annual committed capacity sized for 75% of anticipated peak (we'll model 50–75% headroom).
  - Fixed annual platform license (covers private control plane, management, and security integrations).
  - Overage per 1M tokens at $3,800 (discounted for prepay).
  - Premium support addon: 8% of annual license (24x7, named CSM, quarterly business reviews).
  - Example: 4 envs, committed capacity sized for 30M tokens/day baseline + burst pool = effective ~$3.9k / 1M tokens at projected run-rate.

- Option B — Pilot → commit:
  - 90‑day pilot priced as a short-term reserved pool + higher per-token rate (overage $4,700 / 1M) with credit toward annual commit if converted within 120 days.
  - Pilot includes performance validation window and onboarding hours (fixed).

What we'll include in the formal quote:
- Clear line items: infra (GPU hours), platform license, support, onboarding, SOC2 evidence costs (if applicable).
- Environment count sensitivity: costs for 4 envs vs 6 env split by licensing line item (we assume dev/staging use shared smaller nodes).
- Usage reporting cadence: daily ingestion logs + monthly summary exported to your S3/Kafka (per your preference).

Jordan — I drafted the one-pager and the pricing sheet (attached). If Samira confirms pilot-vs-commit preference and environment count (Samira confirmed 4), we'll produce a formal quote with numbers and a modeled $/1M token table for their expected volumes.

Neha — can you validate whether our SOC2 onboarding items add a fixed one-time fee or should we include as part of the annual license?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Quick summary based on your inputs (4 envs, target ~$4k / 1M):
- We'll model Option A (annual committed) with a 90‑day pilot clause and the conversion credit so you can validate perf.
- Preliminary numbers show ~ $3.8–4.1k / 1M tokens depending on final capacity sizing and DR configuration.
- Premium support at ~8% of license, named CSM during pilot.
- Daily ingestion reports + monthly consolidated billing export.
